test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding the Swadeshi Movement?

options.text: Workers went on strike in different parts of the country.
Widespread support was received from upper class Muslims.
A large number of students participated.
A large number of women participated.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Widespread support was received from upper class Muslims.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During the Swadeshi Movement, the participation of Muslims was largely limited, especially among the upper-class Muslims, as they viewed the movement with suspicion.
 
• Many upper-class Muslims were hesitant to join due to their political alignments and fears that the movement was largely Hindu-dominated.
 
• The Muslim League, formed in 1906, opposed the Swadeshi Movement and sought to protect the interests of Muslims separately.
 
• The Swadeshi Movement was mainly supported by Hindu middle-class leaders, students, and women, but it did not garner significant support from the upper-class Muslim community.
 
• As a result, the statement suggesting widespread support from upper-class Muslims is incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadeshi Movement**

 
 
• The Swadeshi Movement (1905-1908) was launched as a response to the partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon in 1905.
 
• It aimed to promote indigenous products and boycott British goods, thus encouraging self-reliance and economic independence.
 
• Key leaders included **Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Bipin Chandra Pal, Lala Lajpat Rai, and Aurobindo Ghose.**
 
• Major methods included boycotts, strikes, self-reliance, and the promotion of Swadeshi industries and education.
